messages:
mina: Heads up — a customer reported their console shows 0 delta after automatic fallback from v1 route to v2 model. Billing shows charges though. Can repro on their tenant.

oscar: Oof. Which signals disagree? preview delta or meter tag?

mina: Preview delta is 0 in the per-route view. Raw traces show meter=redwood.v2.tokens and route_id still set to /generate/v1.

ria: That sounds like an attribution tag mismatch. Our UI delta logic sums events with meter=route_meter. If the runtime tags meter by model, preview misses it.

adele: Can you dump an example trace and headers? Also which client header they sent?

mina: Pasted: headers captured: `X-Client-Accept: v2`, `X-Route-Id: /generate/v1`. Example trace: trace-fb21. Attached snippet: ```{trace_id: "trace-fb21", meter: "redwood.v2.tokens", route: "/generate/v1", user: "tenant-42"}```

oscar: Thanks. Quick mitigation: we can change the console delta query to fallback to route tag when meter!=route_meter. Minimal patch.

ria: Long term we should have router emit `quota_key=route:<route_id>` and the telemetry pipeline should canonicalize to `quota_key` on every token event.

mina: Agreement. But customers may be confused until we fix it. Recommend a one-time console banner: "We detected inconsistencies between preview and billing for some fallbacks — recalculating now." with a CTA to refresh.

adele: Also recommend enabling a temporary alert: whenever >0.5% of a tenant's token events have meter tag != expected route_meter for 12h, page the oncall so we can act.

oscar: Implementation breakdown: (A) router tag emit (PR in router-core) — tiny change, should be able to ship today to canary; (B) telemetry mapper change — requires infra deploy window, ~48h; (C) console query fallback + banner + orange badge — ~4-6 hours; (D) alert rule + pager playbook — 2 hours. If we parallelize, fix visible in ~2 days.

mina: Who can pick up the router PR? I'll do it if someone reviews quickly.

oscar: I'll review. Please add a feature flag so we can toggle the tag emission per-cluster.

ria: Console change: I'll add a LEFT JOIN on trace_id to find meter mismatches and use COALESCE(quota_key, route_id) where possible. Also will add a small info tooltip explaining why delta may differ from billed tokens.

adele: For customer comms: draft snippet: "We're aware of a mismatch between the console preview and billing for some fallbacks. We're deploying a fix that will ensure the console uses the same canonical quota key as billing. We'll post an update when complete."

mina: CI bot: can we run a targeted backfill to quantify how many tenants affected in last 7 days?

ci-bot: Backfill job queued: job-id=bf-778, scope=last_7d, filter=meter!=route_meter. Estimated time 30m.

mina: Perfect. After backfill we can decide whether to notify finance/CS for tenants with >$250 variance.

oscar: One more thought: add a lightweight runtime flag that when fallback occurs router sets meter to the route's canonical meter in addition to model meter. That gives quick parity while telemetry mapping lands.

ria: That would duplicate tags but is safe. I can add this to the router PR as an opt-in flag.

mina: OK plan: mina -> open router PR with flag; ria -> console query + banner; oscar -> review + merge; adele -> draft tenant message; ci-bot -> post backfill results. Target: canary this week, wide rollout next Tue if canary metrics look good.

oscar: Noted. If backfill shows >50 tenants impacted or >$250/day total variance, escalate to finance.

mina: Thx everyone. I'll keep thread updated and escalate if the backfill shows a big delta. :ok_hand:
